thread:
rlucas: Heads-up — planning to cut release 2.15.0 from branch `release/2.15` tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog approvals, artifact owners, and a quick sanity pass on the sign/verify flow.

maria_h: Ack. I can finish the changelog PR by EOD. @tariq can you confirm who owns the docker image publish?

tariq: I got the image owner. I'll update CI to tag `redwood/runtime:2.15.0-rc1` and push metadata. Which binaries need signing?

sara: The grpc-shim and model-adapter tarballs need signatures. I can run signing after the staging upload. Please use an annotated tag: `v2.15.0-rc1` (policy requirement).

rlucas: Correct — annotated tags only. Example command:
```
git tag -a v2.15.0-rc1 -m "Release 2.15.0 RC1"
git push origin v2.15.0-rc1
```

release-manager: (automated) Friendly reminder: cutoff is tomorrow 09:00 PT. After cutoff, only critical fixes allowed.

maria_h: I'll squash the tiny changelog nit in #changelog-pr by 20:00 PT and request a quick review. :thumbsup: 

tariq: CI note — build matrix will publish artifacts to s3://redwood-ci/releases/2.15.0-rc1. I'll upload SHA256 sums and a small `assets-manifest.json` with file -> digest mapping.

sara: After upload I'll run `gpg --detach-sign` on the artifacts and attach the `.sig` files to the GH draft release.

devops-bot: draft release created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/edit/2.15.0-rc1 (created by release-manager)

rlucas: Quick ask — someone to proof the release note intro. Need a short paragraph describing the quantization improvements + perf numbers.

maria_h: I'll draft the intro now and drop it in the PR in ~15m. Will call out the perf delta with numbers from the perf run.

tariq: Also: can we pin the runtime build to commit `abc1234def` for deterministic artifacts? I'll include the pinned hash in the manifest.

sara: ACK — I'll include pinned hashes and the GPG key id in the release notes and assets manifest.

rlucas: Assuming all green, I'll push the annotated tag at 09:05 PT and then handoff to @release-manager to trigger the publish flow.

release-manager: I'll be on call for the publish window. Plan: wait for artifacts+signatures, verify checksums, then click "Publish" on the draft. If anything blocks, ping me here and I'll pause the release.

maria_h: One last check — any special notes for dedicated customers about the model quantization change? Might be worth a short blurb in the release notes.

rlucas: Good point — add a note about the compatibility flag `--quant-mode=compat` for customers who need the older runtime behavior.

release-manager: All set from my side. Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
